title: Lefty Forehand (Switch On Two)
style: hip hop pop, 116 BPM, coach narrator interlude, whiteboard squeak SFX, male and female duet, snappy snare, cowbell, brass stabs, strategy-talk verses, anthem chorus, sports anthem energy, hooky earworm, sing-along
lyrics:
[Intro — coach voice, whiteboard squeak]
Listen up team.
We switch on two.
We switch on the return.
Lefty forehand stays in the middle.
Lock it in.

[Verse 1 — male lead, easy hip-hop pop]
I got a lefty partner, she's a four-oh weapon
Forehand on the inside, but the rule says we drift the wrong direction
So we SWITCH — same side line-up, swap after the serve
She gets the middle, I take the line, that's the curve

[Pre-Chorus — pop chant]
Switch on the serve, switch on the return
Trade in the middle, watch your partner turn
Lefty middle forehand, righty backhand wide
Switch it up correct, you'll have the point on your side

[Chorus — anthem hook]
LEFTY FOREHAND in the middle of the court
LEFTY FOREHAND, that's the cheat code, sport
LEFTY FOREHAND when she serves and when I serve
Switch it on the two, the strategy of nerve!

[Verse 2 — female lead, smooth]
Most rec players don't know what switching even means
They line up flat-footed, ignore the lefty scenes
Then they wonder why they lose to the four-oh team
Switching is the secret, baby — that's the strategy gleam

[Pre-Chorus]
Switch on the serve, switch on the return
Trade in the middle, watch your partner turn
Lefty middle forehand, righty backhand wide
Switch it up correct, you'll have the point on your side

[Chorus]
LEFTY FOREHAND in the middle of the court
LEFTY FOREHAND, that's the cheat code, sport
LEFTY FOREHAND when she serves and when I serve
Switch it on the two, the strategy of nerve!

[Bridge — coach speaking]
The score is even — left side serves
The score is odd — right side serves
But if you SWITCH, you ignore the rule
You always start where your forehand is cool

[Verse 3 — duet, rapid-fire]
[male] Switch on the serve!
[female] Trade on the bounce!
[male] Lefty in the middle!
[female] Pounce, pounce, pounce!
[male] Drop, soft, attack!
[female] Reset, send it back!
[both] LEFTY FOREHAND! LEFTY FOREHAND!

[Final Chorus — biggest]
LEFTY FOREHAND in the middle of the court
LEFTY FOREHAND, that's the cheat code, sport
LEFTY FOREHAND when she serves and when I serve
Switch it on the two, the strategy of nerve!

[Outro — coach drops paddle]
Now run it back. Eleven points.
Don't forget — switch on two.
GAME ON.
